definitions.explanation: A writing instrument with a graphite core encased in wood. A basic school and office supply.

examples.japanese: {鉛筆|えんぴつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{鉛筆|えんぴつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}して→貸す：00537_kasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{鉛筆|えんぴつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

notes:
{鉛筆|えんぴつ} is a writing instrument with a graphite core, part of basic stationery vocabulary.

COUNTER:
⟦{本|ほん}→〜本：00688_hon⟧ is used: {一|いっ}{本|ぽん}, {二|に}{本|ほん}, {三|さん}{本|ぼん}, etc.

- {鉛筆|えんぴつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write with a pencil
- {鉛筆|えんぴつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{芯|しん}→芯：03888_shin⟧: pencil lead
